high_level_description: The image depicts two individuals shaking hands in front of an aircraft with "UNITED STATES" written on its side. Both individuals appear to be standing on a tarmac, with a red carpet partially visible behind them. In the background, there is a large aircraft, which appears to be Air Force One, identifiable by the emblem and the text on the fuselage.
